metadata.question: On August 6, 2024 at 1:40 pm local time, did land surface temperatures in Paris exceed 32 degrees Celcius?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) – MOD11A1 (Terra, daily 1 km) is the fastest global source for LST; if it is missing we can fall back to MOD11A1.006 or to Landsat, but we start with the most recent “MODIS/061/MOD11A1”. - Date: 2024-08-06 (UTC); 1:40 pm local time in Paris (~UTC+2 in summer) ≈ 11:40 UTC, so we simply take the single date 2024-08-06. - Location: Paris centre (2.35°E, 48.86°N) – sample a 1 km buffer around the point. 2. Masking: - MODIS QA bit 0-1: 00 = good LST; mask to keep only quality 0 pixels. 3. Logic: - If no image exists → C1. - After QA masking, if pixel count inside buffer = 0 → C2. - Extract mean LST (°C) from the “LST_Day_1km” band. - If mean > 32 °C → A / else B. - If result is None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & time pt = ee.Geometry.Point([2.35, 48.86]) # central Paris roi = pt.buffer(1000) # 1 km buffer date = '2024-08-06' # 2. Acquire MODIS LST col = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(date, date) .filterBounds(roi)) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No MODIS image for 2024-08-06.") print("C1") exit() img = col.first() # QA mask: keep only QC = 00 (good) qa = img.select('QC_Day') mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0) lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).updateMask(mask) # 3. Pixel check count = lst.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() if count == 0: print("No valid LST pixels after QA mask.") print("C2") exit() # 4. Calculation meanLST = lst.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() # 5. Validation & answer print(f"LST mean: {meanLST:.2f} °C, Valid pixels: {int(count)}") if meanLST is None: print("C3") elif meanLST > 32: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & time
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([2.35, 48.86])          # central Paris
roi = pt.buffer(1000)                           # 1 km buffer
date = '2024-08-06'

# 2. Acquire MODIS LST
col = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1')
         .filterDate(date, date)
         .filterBounds(roi))
if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No MODIS image for 2024-08-06.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

img = col.first()
# QA mask: keep only QC = 00 (good)
qa = img.select('QC_Day')
mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0)
lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).updateMask(mask)

# 3. Pixel check
count = lst.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                         geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
if count == 0:
    print("No valid LST pixels after QA mask.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# 4. Calculation
meanLST = lst.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                           geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()

# 5. Validation & answer
print(f"LST mean: {meanLST:.2f} °C, Valid pixels: {int(count)}")
if meanLST is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif meanLST > 32:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
